mission.title: Destiny
mission.description: Solve Meillak's last riddles to find Caboclo's final message.

npc.say: This is going to be rewarding on so many levels.

phase.briefing:
Operative, Meillak has been terminated by Unlimit soldiers, after refusing to surrender himself to us. We had hoped that his knowledge of Caboclo's research into Anome's past might reveal a clue to Anome's current location. Meillak's dying message was "Choice."
The meaning of this message--aside from his having used the word several times in the message he left you recently--was unclear, until now. An anonymous bulletin board post, titled "Caboclo," following the pattern of his previous postings, has just appeared, its contents encrypted. The decryption key was "Choice."
As usual, the message contained a set of coordinates. Proceed to the indicated area and investigate.

enter.say: I've got a bit of an electronic signal in there, but it's pretty faint.

done.say:
Aw, bag it; there's nothing there. That signal I thought I had was just background noise.
I don't get it; I thought Meillak wanted to help us get Anome for slaughtering Meillak's pal, Caboclo. Is Meillak screwing around with us now that he's dead?
Speaking of which, isn't it kind of creepy that this is all still happening after his own death?

phase.briefing:
{player}, we know that Meillak used every means possible to avoid interception of his messages by Unlimit. It appears that "Choice" was what you call a "red herring." A network trace of the bulletin board post has revealed that it originated at a heretofore-hidden private network hub. Meillak must have feared that Unlimit could have overheard his final word, and counted on our unmatched network resources to uncover the true solution to his puzzle, hidden from his Unlimit enemies.
You are now being sent to the correct destination.

enter.say: There's a hefty network running through every wall in that place, {player}. Meillak was wired! That must have been his real base of operations.

done.say: "Thank you"? That's it? He said he'd have one last message for you, brings you to his home, and it was just to say "thank you"? I don't believe this guy! Why, if he wasn't dead, I'd--

phase.briefing:
0.041 seconds after you read that message, operative, another anonymous bulletin board message with strongly encrypted contents was posted and detected by our spiders. Our attempt to decrypt it with every possible combination of the words in his "thank you" message has failed. At this time, I fail to see--
Yes? Indeed; his calling you "Captain" recalls his mention of a belief that "we are captains of our own destiny" in the message he left for you in which he predicted his own death--a piece of "poetic license" of the kind that you humans are so fond--
Eh? "Destiny"? Very well, operative; it appears to be a questionable leap in logic, but I will check...
... "Destiny" has decrypted his bulletin board post. It contains nothing but the word "Life," but we have traced the network origin successfully. Proceed, {player}.

enter.say: Psst! I don't think Gray's very good at the poetry!
Bingo! I've got a simulacrum reading in there. Wait a sec, that looks like--nah, couldn't be...

talk.say: It is! Anome's simulacrum! What's that bucket of bolts doing there? Something about it looks weird...

done.say:
Hahaha! Meillak hacked Anome's own simulacrum! Hahaha! Oh man, I swear that almost makes up for him hacking an Agent.
Uh... I think it wants to follow you outside.

objective.text: Lead the Anome Simulacrum out of the area

phase.briefing: That simulacrum is attracting Unlimit attention for obvious reasons, operative. However, it seems as if it is trying to direct you somewhere. I have marked the projected destination for you. Scanners indicate that there is a working computer there. Make sure that the simulacrum arrives intact.

enter.say:
I'm reading a dormant system in there. Maybe we need the simulacrum to activate it.
Oh man, I crack up every time I get a scan of that thing--it looks so dorky!

I just detected a power fluctuation in that computer system. I think--
Unlimit! We can't let them see the message! Take them out!

done.say: You're clear! That computer just lit up.

Another terminal just sprung to life in there, {player}; that must be it--Caboclo's final message.
I don't see what it could be that would really help us, though. More about Anome's mother fixation? Maybe he wets his bed? Interesting stuff, sure, but...

Oh. Yeah... Yeah, I think we can use that.
I'm going to upload a copy of that message to your inventory, {player}, so make sure you have some space free before you leave the area, or you won't be able to receive it.

Like I said, make sure you have some inventory space freed up before you leave the mission area, or else you won't be able to receive this copy of Caboclo's last message that I'm going to upload to you.

mission.finish:
I still fail to understand the significance of Meillak's last decrypted bulletin board post, {player}. "Life"? "Destiny"? There seems to be another riddle here that our systems have yet to decode.
Regardless, thanks to that final message, we now know Anome's location; he is under surveillance as we speak. Make no move there yourself, operative; our project to deliver the kill code, based on Caboclo's research into Anome's past, is already underway.
Anome's deletion is...predestined.
